messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

I found your line (555-123-2002) and I can see that roaming was not enabled on your line. I've just enabled international roaming for you at no cost.

Now, since you're abroad in France, let me guide you through some troubleshooting steps to improve your mobile data speed. Let's start by checking your current network status.

Please use the following action on your phone:
**check_network_status**

This will show me your current connection status, including whether mobile data is enabled and if data roaming is turned on in your phone settings.

I checked my network status, and it shows that my phone is connected with an excellent cellular signal and 5G network type. Mobile data is enabled, but data roaming is currently off on my phone. Wi-Fi is off, and I am not connected to any Wi-Fi network. What should I do next?

Please explain the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
